scope: Current-wallet Aster trading grant, existing EOA subaccounts, ordinary deposits and own-address withdrawals; real acceptance deferred

authorization.optional_withdraw: Explicit opt-in and nonempty literal IP/CIDR whitelist; no builder/key/additional wallet
authorization.checks: Independent signed Futures and Spot account reads; canTrade and optional canWithdraw; Spot read acceptance does not prove Spot trading grant

subaccounts.create: POST /fapi/v3/createSubAccount; child signature over encoded name/source/nonce/user/signer, then master signs including childSignature
subaccounts.transfer: POST /fapi/v3/subAccountTransfer; toAccountAddress,asset,amount,kindType,nonce,user,fromAccountAddress; documented user OR signer, user only chosen
subaccounts.qualification: Fresh master directory, exactly one parent marker, create max10; no address/status inference
subaccounts.switch: Logout and fresh target-bound wallet SIWE; no local active account substitution
limitations: Existing independent child EOA and manual external childSignature; 45s total review
No remote freeze status or child available balance preflight

encoding: URI application/x-www-form-urlencoded exact bytes signed and sent; spaces +, IPv6/CIDR escaped. General V3 URL encoding and raw demo concatenation differ; non-ASCII name/IP server behavior pending.

deposits.minimum: Public minimum preferred; if omitted user must enter externally verified minimum (zero only if verified no positive minimum)
deposits.platform_caps: Unavailable BAPI auth; explicit user external verification, never interpreted as unlimited
deposits.submission: Fresh catalog, balance/allowance/Gas/nonce twice, immutable exact tx review, approval/deposit mutex and pending journal checks, flush before send
deposits.receipt: Exact intent/chain/nonce and canonical >=2 confirmations; manual same-intent speedup hash permitted
deposits.credit: Retain chain success until signed history exact hash,market,chain,asset,Decimal amount and unique SUCCESS

withdrawals.review: Fresh master directory, catalog, signed info and fee; repeat before submit, 30s expiry, amount+fee conservative quantity/USD caps
withdrawals.business_nonce: milliseconds x1000 per Action table, numeric EVM example and official web frontend
withdrawals.nonce_conflict: V3 userNonce prose says nanoseconds; inconsistent with own example/table/frontend. LIVE ACCEPTANCE UNVERIFIED.
withdrawals.response: withdrawId is reference; hash is signature digest, NOT on-chain tx hash
withdrawals.recovery: Signed history exact withdrawId/market/chain/asset/amount; unknown without ID cannot resolve by balances or reissue

durability.terms: Public unsigned exact intent only; no signatures/keys
durability.bounded: max100 each, no silent eviction; account journal no archival UI
durability.unknown: blocks another operation for same wallet; retained across stop/logout; no auto replay
durability.limitation: No official original-nonce lookup for unknown sub transfer/withdrawal without returned ID; requires platform verification
